about.author: pddmergilla
about.note: Each hack's new bytes only, made by harness/make_hack_patches.py

hacks.label: MiniMap
hacks.summary: A small map in the corner shows where you are.

hacks.label: Fast Warp
hacks.summary: Warp rooms send you on your way much faster.

hacks.label: Damage Number Colors
hacks.summary: Damage numbers show at a glance when you hit a weakness or a resistance.

hacks.label: Swap Power of Mist and Gas Cloud
hacks.summary: Power of Mist and Gas Cloud trade places, which changes your route through the castle.

hacks.label: Aggressive Enemy
hacks.summary: Enemies notice Alucard from much farther away.

hacks.label: No Flinch Karasuman
hacks.summary: Karasuman keeps coming no matter how hard you hit him.

hacks.label: No Flinch Slogra
hacks.summary: Slogra holds his ground when hit, so Gaibon can no longer carry him into their combo.

hacks.label: No Flinch Dopplegangers
hacks.summary: Both Doppelgangers fight straight through your hits.

hacks.label: No Flinch and Faster Succubus
hacks.summary: Succubus only flinches during her clone attack and fights faster.

hacks.label: No Flinch Richter
hacks.summary: Richter shrugs off your hits.

hacks.label: Epic Richter AI
hacks.summary: Richter's AI has been reworked, and it is much more amazing.

hacks.label: Richter always saved
hacks.summary: You can save Richter after you get the Holy Glasses, but you still need to fight and defeat him.

hacks.label: Quick Items
hacks.summary: Hold L2 and press a face button to use an item without opening the menu. Choose the items for the shortcut by equipping them in the equipment menu.

hacks.label: MP Cost Items instead of consumables
hacks.summary: Potions and other items are no longer used up; each use costs MP instead, and an item you cannot pay for cannot be used.

hacks.label: Healing items use Hearts instead of MP
hacks.summary: Healing items cost hearts instead of MP, from the menu and from the L2 shortcut.

hacks.label: Instant Food
hacks.summary: Food heals the moment you use it, and the Meal Ticket serves up a random dish.

hacks.label: Eat Food on Pickup
hacks.summary: Food you find is eaten on the spot.

hacks.label: Subweapon use MP instead of Hearts
hacks.summary: Alucard's subweapons spend MP instead of hearts.

hacks.label: Agunea Limit
hacks.summary: Agunea's lightning chain has a limit, so it cannot run forever.

hacks.label: Stopwatch slows bosses
hacks.summary: The Stopwatch's freeze is shorter, but bosses that used to ignore it are now slowed by it.

hacks.label: Richter-style Holy Water
hacks.summary: Holy Water flies in Richter's arc, and its fire races along the floor.

hacks.label: No Jump Wolf Transformation
hacks.summary: Turning into the Wolf no longer makes Alucard hop.

hacks.label: Subweapon Attached to Weapon
hacks.summary: Every weapon you equip comes with a subweapon attached.

hacks.label: Heart Regeneration
hacks.summary: Hearts slowly come back on their own, faster with more CON.

hacks.label: Dark Metamorphosis stat buff
hacks.summary: Dark Metamorphosis, the buff potions and the Faerie's buffs raise Alucard's stats based on his base stats.

hacks.label: Dark Metamorphosis SpeedUp
hacks.summary: Dark Metamorphosis makes Alucard faster on his feet.

hacks.label: Sky Walker
hacks.summary: The Leap Stone becomes Sky Walker: jump in midair as often as you like, and press Down + X at any time to dropkick.

hacks.label: Faerie Behavior
hacks.summary: The Faerie stops using up your items and casts buffs when you get hit.
